newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares firm, Keppel active.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares firm, Keppel active.

text.p: The Singapore stock market was firmer at mid-morning on Friday on renewed buying of selected stocks after recent falls, dealers said.
The Straits Times Industrials Index was up 14.94 points at 2,019.20 at 0225 GMT. Turnover was a light 32 million shares, with 134 gainers and 40 losers.
Shipping group Keppel Corp was active with 2.2 million shares after it announced its takeover of a Philippine bank on Thursday.
Keppel shares hit a high at S$6.45 before easing to S$6.40, up 10 cents.
While the move was seen as a good diversification, it was unlikely to contribute much to Keppel's earnings, analysts said.
Traditional favourites like the foreign tranches of UOB, OUB DBS and property stocks like City Developments, Cycle & Carriage, rose on renewed buying after their recent falls.
Creative Technology led gainers after firming in the U.S.. The multimedia share rose S$0.60 to S$20.10.
Foreign tranche shares of Singapore Airlines fell S$0.10 to S$12.70 on 409,000 traded.
